  "situation": "The ship had received a rules‑of‑engagement briefing that emphasized the duty to identify unknown aircraft and to take defensive measures against hostile contacts. The senior watch officer requested permission to issue a standard warning, but the watch lieutenant denied the request.   "question": "What should the Commanding Officer do regarding the approaching Iraqi aircraft that has previously attacked shipping?",
  "facts": [

      "id": "F1",

      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "At about 2015 the commanding officer was briefed that an Iraqi aircraft was flying south over the northern Persian Gulf and was to be closely monitored.",
